hypothesis: repeat views of identical positive physical observations over-weight a few supervision groups, especially Onset; rebalance window mass without deleting any positives
features: unchanged R10 555; no group ID, multiplicity, factor or future metadata as inference input
Onset: inverse shared-observation group size, equal total positive mass per group
Ongoing: inverse square root group size, softer correction retaining duration variation; only severe-overlap eligible groups
group_semantics: components of windows sharing identical eligible positive timestamp/link cells, within day/panel/condition; NOT independent physical episodes
sampling: all original R10 X/y/cells and within-window IPW retained; positive-window class mass .8 / negative .2 unchanged; all row weights positive
probe_scope: June-September factors and normalizers derived ONLY from that period; full factors use June-November
training_gate: R24 early windows/groups>=1.5, >=30 groups, factor std>=.05
temporal: October-November original windows vs identical-feature old R10 early200; median gain .1/.2/.35>=-.01 plus negative guard and Dec>=4 per phase
negative_guard: unchanged thresholds .5/.25; false-any increase<=.03 and eligible-cell FP increase<=.005, early holdout and January per-condition global calibration
January: two global blends0/.5/1, fixed thresholds; no per-road tuning
baseline: R23 frozen January policy, retained despite mixed repeated-February reports; do not rollback using February
